profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at LinkedIn
profile.summary: Experienced Full Stack Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the information services industry. Skilled in .Net Framework, C#, ASP.Net Web API/MVC,  AngularJS, JQuery, SQL Server, Software as a Service (SaaS), and HTML/CSS. Good understanding of cloud infrastructure of AWS, EC2, S3, SQS, EBS etc. Adaptable software engineer who loves to learn new technologies.  Some more personal experience in Java Spring Boot Framework, Angular, MySql  etc. Strong engineering professional with a Master’s Degree focused in Computer Software Engineering from Southern Methodist University.

positions.title: Software Developer - ||
positions.description: • Currently developing Micro service architecture for consumer requests to get MVR reports. Developing micro service using JAVA Spring Boot API. Designing the spring cloud config server for the configuration management for application. Designing database using the PostgreSql. Using AWS API Gateway for hosting the microservice. Running the microservice on AWS EC2 instance using Docker. Integrated Swagger Documentation UI for microservice

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Working as a full stack developer with the process improvement and automation team (Lean Six Sigma)
• Developed a case management software for FCRA process. Automated the whole workflow of report generation and gathering. Improved turnaround time by 50%. Replaced a full FTE with the software. Developed the web tool using ASP.Net Web API, AngularJS and SQL server
• Developed a tracking component for content manager website which is used for roll outs of forms and circulars. Started from scratch as a requirement and developed job assignment and dashboard functionality based on user roles. Integrated full features into the content manager website. Improved the process efficiency by 70% by turning the whole assignment and emailing the task information which was manual process into an automated system which indeed saved around 100k for a year. Developed tools using ASP.Net MVC, SQL Server
• Developed a small POC project on a board game called CATAN to generate random maps using JAVA Spring boot, AngularJS. And hosted the API into aws EC2. Hosted the front end in S3. Did a presentation with a live link given to each of the user to generate random maps 
• Using JIRA for issue tracking, bitbucket, GitLab for version control
• Using Octopus and Bamboo/Jenkins for automated Deployments
• Writing Unit Tests using xUnit/nUnit/jUnit Framework
• Hands on experience on AWS EC2, S3, EBS, SQS

positions.title: Software Developer Intern (ASP.Net MVC, C#, SQL)
positions.description:
•	Worked as full stack developer for Insightly's CRM web application. Worked on Saas  
•	Worked on technologies like ASP.Net MVC, C#, JQuery, Javascript, Redis, AWS, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS, SQL (MSSQL)
•	Helped team to develop salesforce migrator. If client wants to switch to new CRM they can just get the salesforce data file and can upload the file to Insightly which will migrate all data to insightly’s portal  
•	Developed @Mentions utility in Insightly CRM where users can mention any other user and that user will be notified via app and email regarding the comment
•	Developed Browser Based uploads functionality in website using AWS S3. Developed as POC which indeed helped the team reduce the traffic load on servers by a good amount

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: •	Working on the in creating python scripts to configure devices such as Cisco 2811 and Cisco 2821 so as to communicate with them using GNS3 using different protocols

positions.title: Software developer intern (C#/ASP.net, Wordpress)
positions.description:
•	Worked on a live website WWW.HOOTEDUCATION.COM 
•	Handled the front-end website through WORDPRESS using CSS and PHP to create attractive, user friendly and responsive UI 
•	Developed use-cases for the backend for the entire website for each functionality. Worked on bug fixes for portal using ASP/C#.net 
•	Did Manual and Usability Testing on whole website for ensuring the functionality
•	Gave technical support to teachers of schools for any problems faced on the website

projects.title: Catan Map Generator
projects.description:
I have been working on this project for my own interest for a board game called Catan.
- The board consist of a map that needs to be randomized each time you play
- Developed the logic in the back-end using Rest API in Java Spring boot (Maven)
- Developed the front end to display the map in Angular
- Hosted the full application by creating my own AWS account. Hosted the API on the AWS EC2 instance  using elastic beanstalk
- Hosted the front end on AWS S3 which uses the rest url that will call the api on ec2
- Currently working on the next phase of the project which is generating the balanced map where each player gets the same amount of probability on the map 
**(Currently I have shut down the server because of the free-tier account but can be turned on upon the request)

projects.title: Mobile phone controlled Paper airplane
projects.description:
•	Developed in iOS 8 using Objective C with UIKit and CoreMotion Library
•	Developed an iOS application that controls a paper airplane, Used Blend Micro (Arduino + Bluetooth) chip
•	Used Motion sensor of iPhone to control the rudder and slider to control fan speed. Range was 60 meters
•	Blend Micro, Rudder and fan were attached using a carbon fiber material which makes it very light weighted
•	When app is opened at that time it gives option to connect to blend micro using Bluetooth and then you can fly and control
